bio: Located in the centre of Ligist, this restaurant run by the Wörgötter family has won diners over with its twin dining concepts: Wirtshaus (Traditional Inn) and Fine Dining. The latter proposes creative, modern cuisine that draws on international influences. At the helm in the kitchen, Florian Wörgötter represents the third generation of the family and is supported by his father Mathias. The reasonably priced surprise menu impresses with well thought-out combinations that create interesting contrasts and are packed with wonderful flavours: yellowfin tuna, beer radish, jalapeño, shiso, or pork greaves, gyoza, pointed cabbage, brown butter. Select a bottle from the nicely curated wine list, or opt for harmonious wine pairings by the glass to set off the menu perfectly. Guests take their seats...
